messages:
ops-bot: alert: remote_write error rate > 5% for cluster ap-sg-gpu-pool (2765432100)
alyssa: seeing p95/p99 spike for prom->remote_write, dashboards: https://grafana.company.net/d/abcd/prom-rw-latency
jonah: queue depth on sidecars climbing, p99 enqueue time is through the roof
maria: did we have any egress maintenance? I saw a natgw rotation job at ~02:05 UTC :thinking_face:
jonah: yes, blue/green NATGW rotation to pick up security patch at 02:04-02:06
alyssa: that would change source IPs. our relabeler was recently changed to keep `source_ip` for debug — could be creating new label variants per ephemeral ip
kevin: why were we carrying source IP into metrics? that seems like a cardinality timebomb
maria: devs added `source_ip` relabel to help trace a networking blip, forgot to anchor or drop it after debug
alyssa: timeline looks like: nat rotation -> many new series with different src ip labels -> remote_write latency + timeouts -> retries and queue growth
sre-oncall: remote_write errors showing 502/504 and TLS timeouts, retry backoff ramped up, queue backed up
jonah: example logs from sidecar:

```
W0503 02:07:12.342 prom-sidecar: remote_write failed: Post "https://rw.company.net/api/v1/receive": net/http: TLS handshake timeout
W0503 02:07:12.342 prom-sidecar: enqueuing 1200 samples for retry
```

alyssa: rw endpoint p95 jumped from 200ms -> 6s around the same time
maria: quick mitigation proposal: hotpatch relabel_config to drop `source_ip`/`natip` labels: `- action: labeldrop\n  regex: "^source_ip$|^natip$"` and roll the config out to sidecars
jonah: also temporarily raise remote_write timeout to 30s (was 10s) to reduce transient failures during drain
kevin: +1. we should also add a relabel test in CI to prevent this class of changes
sre-oncall: on it — patching prometheus configmap in monitoring namespace now
sre-oncall: `kubectl -n monitoring patch configmap prometheus-server --patch '{"data": {"prometheus.yml": "<patched>"}}'`
deploybot: deploybot: configmap updated (deploy id 2765432159)
maria: restarting sidecars to pick up new config: `kubectl rollout restart daemonset/prometheus-sidecar -n monitoring`
alyssa: watch prometheus_tsdb_head_series and prom_remote_write_queue_length as indicators
jonah: after restart series count stabilized, queue drained back to baseline within ~6 minutes
maria: there are still ingestion gaps between 02:05-02:12 for some GPU exporter metrics, likely lost during retries
kevin: follow-up: revert the debug relabel in git and add a promtool unit test for labeldrop rules
alyssa: propose new alert: `remote_write_label_churn_rate > 50/min` to auto-trigger relabel rollback runbook
sre-oncall: filing follow-up issue: ops/observability#432 (add tests, runbook, cost estimate)
maria: cost impact FYI — the ephemeral series churn increased TSDB head memory and will add ~1.2GB/day until compaction, billing might spike for affected tenant slices
jonah: I'll run compaction in staging and estimate storage fallout, will post numbers
alyssa: let's add NATGW rotation note to infra runbook and require a smoke check for prom ingestion after rotation
sre-oncall: closing thread for now, monitoring alerts will reopen if any aftershocks :thumbsup:
